book.name: Matei
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Matei

content: Yecho ajhingii ku Yeluchalemo kwa ilulo
Yecho na bhabholwa bhake pubhabhandikila kuhika ku Yeluchalemo na kuhika ku Betifage pakitombe chuku Micheitune. Yecho ajhakwatuma bhabholwa bhake bhabhele,
ajhakwalobholela, “Nnyende ade pachenda jha palonge jhino na namukolela liponda likongilwe na libhii na litohe lyake. Mulijhoghole na nhwike nako kwa nenga.
Anda mundo ankonyite nhwalo gwa nike mutenda naha, munnobholele, ‘Bhambo alipala,’ na jwenio nanekekeya papa.”
Kilebhe chenie kitendika kupala ghakamilike ghighalongilwa na nnondole jwa Chapanga,

content.text: “Mwalobholele bhando bha muche kwa ku Sayune
Dolekeya, Munahota nkolongwa gwino atenda kuhika!
Abhii nhihimo na atamite panane jha liponda.
Ahika panane jha mwana liponda, kinyama chikijhegha mihigho.”

content: Bhahe, bhabholwa bhajhakujhenda na kutenda ngita Yecho chibhalaghalikiye.
Bhajhakunetela liponda Yecho pamonga na litohe lyake, bhajhakujhala ngobho panane jhabhe na Yecho ajhakutama panane jhake.
Bhahe, lilongo lya bhando lijhakujhala ngobho undela, bhange bhajhakujhala matuto gha mikongo mwenio undela.
Lilongo lya bhando likalongolile na lela lilikengima unyuma jhake bhajhakunonoha malobhe, “Ulombwe Mwana gwa Daude! Jhuna mota jwahika kwa liina lya Bhambo! Chapanga alombwe kunane!”
Yecho pajhingila ku Yeluchalemo bhando bhoha bhajhakubhehe ngenyangenya. Bhando bhajhakunkonya, “Jhonjo ngohe ndi ghane?”
Bhahe, lilongo lya bhando ujhakujhanguu, “Jwenio ndi nnondole Yecho, ahumii ku Nachalete ku muche gwa ku Galilaya.”
Yecho pa Nyumba jha Chapanga

Peniya Yecho ajhakujhingii pa Nyumba jha Chapanga, na kutumbuu kwabhenga bhando bhoha panja bhibhachulwicha na kuhemela ilebhe mwenio. Helahela ajhakupendengula njangwale yabhe ibhajhanganganila mbijha na igoda ya bhala bhibhachulwicha ngunda.
Ajhakwalobholela, “Ijhandikwe naha mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga, ‘Nyumba jhango nahibha nyumba jha kunnyope Chapanga.’ Mangota mwenga uyohite nkwembe gwa kukwatulila ilebhe!”
Bhangalola na bhibhalemile bhajhakunyendelela Yecho pa Nyumba jha Chapanga, na jwenio ajhakwalamicha.

Bhahe, Akapiya matambiko bhakolo na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo bhajhakuyoma pubhalolita iiebhe yambone yatehila Yecho, na kujhoha yana ikachobhela pa Nyumba jha Chapanga ilongila, “Nnombwe mwenga, Mwana gwa Daude!”

Bhahe, bhajhakunkonya Yecho, “Bho, nnyohine malobhe ghibhalonge yana hengeno?” Yecho ajhakwajhanguu, “Chakaka, nnyohine. Nambo mukachomite ndeka mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghighalonge, ‘Kuhuma mumilomo jha yana napokela chipwa jhilenganile.’ ”
Bhahe, ajhakwaleka na kujhenda ku Betaniya na ajhakugholoka koko.
Yecho aulapanikiya nkongo gwa nkojho
Lukala jhake Yecho pabhujhita ku Yeluchalemo, ajhakubhona njala.

Ajhakubhona nkongo gwa nkojho mupele jha ndela, ajhakuheghelela nambo ukapambike ndeka nga mahamba tebha. Yecho ajhakulapanikiya alongila, “Kubhoke ngoheno nkotoka kupambika uhohe kabhele!” Papalapala nkongo ghola ujhakujhoma.
Bhabholwa pubhalolita kilebhe chenie bhajhakuhechuka hake na kukikonya, “Nhwalo gwa nike nkojho ghongo ujhomite kajhombe?”

Yecho ajhakwajhanguu, “Ninobholela chakaka, nkwete jhe kiholo, mihoto kuhenga chindeile kwa nkojho ghongo. Na kupeta kwa lyenio mihoto kukilobholela kitombe chenje, ‘Heghela hoko, mukitaghile kumbwane,’ nahitendeka hele.
Anda mmii na kihobholelo, kilebhe chochoha chimujhopa mu kumnyopa Chapanga, nampelwa.”
Ukindendeke gwa Yecho uhuma kojhe?

Peniya Yecho ajhakujhingii pa Nyumba jha Chapanga, atehila kubhola. Akapiya matambiko bhakolo pamonga na ighogholo bhajhakunyendelela na kunkonya, “Bho, muhenga ghangano kwa ukindendeke gwa ghane? Na ghane ngohe jwapekiye mwenga ukindendeke gwenio?”
Yecho ajhakwajhanguu, “Na nenga ninkonye kilebhe chimo. Anda unyangwii, helahela naninobholela nihenga kwa ukindendeke gwa ghane.

Bho, ukindendeke gwa Yohane gwa kubaticha bhando uhumila kwa ghane, kwa Chapanga amu kwa bhando?” “Bhene bhajhakubhehe chwapu, anda tulongile ukindendeke gwake, ‘Uhumii kwa Chapanga,’ natukonya, ‘Nhwalo gwa nike ngohe minyeketela ndeka?’
Anda tulongile, ‘Uhumila kwa bhando,’ tujhoghopa lilongo lya bhando nhwalo bhoha bhajheketela kubhehe Yohane akibha nnondole jwa Chapanga.”
Bhahe, bhajhakunnyanguu Yecho, “Tumanyite ndeka.” Na jwenio ajhakwalobholela, “Na nenga hele naninobholela ndeka nihenga kwa ukindendeke gwa ghane.
Nnandanikiho gwa ichongolo ibhele

“Yecho ajhakuchocha kulonge, bho, mangota mihola nike panane jha ilebhe hengeno? Pakibha na mundo jhumo jwakibha na ichongolo ibhele, ajhakutumbula kunobholela mwana jwa kutumbula, ‘Mwanango, deleno mukahenge mughonda gwa michabibo.’
Na mwana jhola jwa kutumbula ajhakujhanguu, ‘Mbahijhe,’ nambo paligha ajhakujheketela kujhenda kuhenga lihengo.
Tate mundo jhola ajhakunobholela mwana mundo jhubhele jhola ngita chanobholila jwatumbwila jhola. Na jwenio ajhakujhanguu, ‘Nijhenda tate!’ Nambo ajhenda ndeka.

Bho, ghane pakate jha bhabhele bhano jwateile ghaghapala tate gwabhe?” Bhajhakunyanguu, “Ndi jhola jwatumbwila kunobholela.” Bhahe, Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Ninobholela chakaka, bhiakatola kode na bhibhatenda ngongola nabhannongolela mangota kujhingii mu Nahota gwa Chapanga.

Nhwalo Yohane akahikite kwino kunangiya ndela jha chakaka jha kutama, na mangota mikanyeketi ndeka. Nambo akatola kode na bhatenda ngongola bhanyeketile. Pamonga na kulola ilebhe yoha yenio mangota mulekite ndeka uhakaho gwino na kunnyeketela.”
Nnandanikiho gwa nghonda gwa michabibo na bhando bhubhajhahike

Peniya Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Nnyokanikiye nnandanikiho ghonge. Mundo jhumo ajhakulema nghonda gwa michabibo, ajhakutindikiya ubhegho, ajhakutengenecha chehemo jha kuminyila chabibo, na kuchenga kilendo kitandamaho. Ajhakwajhahikicha bhubhalema na jwenio kujhenda ku kilambo chukutale.
Pughahikita machiko gha mahuno, ajhakwatuma akatumiche bhake bhajhende kwa bhala bhubhajhahike mighonda, bhakatole lipungo lyake lya mahuno.
Nambo bhala bhubhajhahike mighonda bhajhakwakamula akatumiche bhala. Jhumo bhajhakuntyala, na jhonge bhajhakunkoma na jhonge bhajhakukong'onda maghanga.
Nkolo nghonda jhola ajhakwatuma akatumiche bhange bhamahele, nambo bhala bhubhajhahike mighonda bhajhakwetendela hele.
Na kujhomolela kwake ajhakuntuma mwana mundo kwabhene, ‘Kongo awachila, nabhanyeketela nhwalo mwanango.’
Nambo bhubhalema bhala pubhamwenita mwana jhola, bhajhakupwepwelana, ‘Jhonjo ngoheno ndi nabhujhila mighonda, tunkome na nghonda ghongo tubhujhii twenga!’
Bhahe, bhajhakunkamula, bhajhakunhutila kutale na nghonda gwa michabibo ghola na kunkoma.”
“Bho, ngohe nkolo nghonda papalakuhika, nabhatenda nike bhubhajhahike bhenabha?”
Na bhene bhajhakunyanguu, “Nabhalobholela chakaka nabhakoma bhando bhanganandela bhene na nghonda gwenio nabhapela bhando bhange, ndi nabhampela lipungo lya mahuno ghake chiipalwa.”
Yecho ajhakwajhanguu, “Bho, mukachomite jhe kilebhe chenje mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga?

content.text: ngoheno lihyokite lighanga lilipalwa hake kuliku ghoha.
nalyene ndi lya kukangacha hake kwito!’

content: “Kwa nhwalo ghongo,” “Unahota gwa Chapanga nahubhoka kwito na kupelwa bhando bha ilambo henge bhibhahenga ghapala Chapanga.”
Mundo jhojhoha jwapala kugwelelwa na lighanga lyenio naheketwa imbembela imbembela, na lighanga lyenio anda ligwelikile mundo jhojhoha naliyogha yoghoyogho.
Akapiya matambiko bhakolo na Mapwalichayo pubhajhohina milandanikiho jhene, bhajhakumanya kubhehe alongila panane jhabhe.
Bhahe, bhajhakupalaha ndela jha kukamuu Yecho, nambo bhajhogwipa bhando nhwalo bhene bhakanhwachile kubhehe jwenio ndi nnondole jwa Chapanga.
